lines.t: I called your name before the stars were lit,
Formed your heart that you might not forget.
My words are life, they never fade away,
Follow the path I’ve set, don’t stray.
Walk in My ways, beloved child of Mine,
Keep My commandments, let your heart align.
Honor My Sabbaths, where peace remains,
Rest in My presence, free from pain.
The world may turn, the shadows may rise,
But truth will shine where My spirit lies.
Lift up your eyes and hear My call,
Stand in My Word, you will not fall.
Walk in My ways, beloved child of Mine,
Keep My commandments, let your heart align.
Honor My Sabbaths, where peace remains,
Rest in My presence, free from pain.
In quiet waters I will lead your soul,
In stillness deep, I’ll make you whole.
The seventh day I blessed for you,
A gift of rest, forever true.
Walk in My ways, beloved child of Mine,
Keep My commandments, your light will shine.
Honor My Sabbaths, your strength renewed,
Rest in My love, forever true.
